content:
**Inspirational** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases XP gain based on Charisma, while being part of a team.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain more XP while on a team based on your CHA. | 001D2461 | 

The perk checks if the number of teammates is greater than 0, and will therefore not work if the player is on a team by themselves.
